scientific_question: Can a train-only calibrated temporal statistic distinguish an unseen adjacent-swap negative from a correctly ordered noisy positive, not merely distinguish large global permutations?
hypothesis: Local transition mismatch has better discriminability than mean positional mismatch when the heldout perturbation is an adjacent tail swap; no guarantee under fresh dynamics and stronger jitter.
generator: NEW nonlinear 16-tick four-channel dynamics, first channel (192+seed+7*q+3*t+t*t)%256, other three inherited W-R17 formulas with nonlinear increments (t*t,2*t*t,3*t*t); q=(5*entity+seed)%9. First channel receives full-mod256 channel offset and genuine varying tick jitter, development ((5*t+entity+seed)%3)-1, heldout ((7*t+entity+seed)%5)-2, with asserted cardinality 3 and 5. Positives have jitter+offset but retained order. Negative development reverse 15-tick tail on even entities, rotate3 on odd; negative heldout swaps adjacent tail positions at original ticks 7 and 8. Both labels share first candidate row and sorted candidate multiset.
arms: mean of 16 first-channel anchor-relative circular positional mismatch
maximum of 16 first-channel anchor-relative circular positional mismatch
mean of 15 local transition circular mismatches between consecutive observations
learning: For each arm derive ONE scalar threshold (max development-positive score + min development-negative score)/2 with no heldout influence. Positive iff score<=threshold. All arms same development 72 pairs and exactly one learned scalar, no budget tuning.
primary: Each arm 4 heldout seed confusion matrices and total accuracy. LOCAL_ORDER_TRANSFER if transition>=0.85 and histogram<=0.55, PARTIAL if transition strictly exceeds mean position and unordered without reaching threshold, else NEGATIVE; archive all arm results including if maxima/positives overlap. Distinguish algorithmic failure from generator invalidity.
independent_controls: No exact duplicate train-vs-heldout base seeds; disjoint 48..51 and 52..55; equality of candidate multisets for positive and negative, genuine nonconstant per-tick noise in both, no future labels, exact Git objects, first-use once, deterministic replay, final full go regression.
claim_limit: Frozen toy synthetic temporal pair discrimination, NOT general-purpose semantic intelligence; new generator is not a natural dataset.
